description: Prices upcoming weekends (Fri–Sun, 2 nights) to find the cheapest times to stay. Pass hotel_id for one hotel across ~8 weekends, or just a city to compare Fostay's curated stays (Dubai, Abu Dhabi) or top-rated Goa hotels across the next ~6 weekends. Cheapest options first.

currency.description: Currency to quote in (AED, INR, EUR, AUD, SGD, NZD). Defaults to the hotel's home currency: INR for Goa, AED for Dubai and Abu Dhabi. The price quoted is the price charged.
